summary: Iter78 backend + frontend validation for Coparenting Journey Toolkit rebuild and new Complete Report PDF endpoint. Backend: 8/8 pytest scenarios green — POST /api/portal/complete-report-pdf returns 200 application/pdf with %PDF- header for rich AND empty {} payloads (2466-byte empty stub PDF), foundation_text > 8000 chars is rejected 422 by Pydantic max_length, share mint with artefact_type='complete' works (both no-passphrase 30d and passphrase 7d gates), and GET /api/portal/share/{id}.pdf serves the regenerated bundle PDF; all three legacy artefact_types (foundation/legal/weekly) still mint + serve correctly. Frontend at 390x844 verified via preview URL (unauthenticated portal): door label reads 'Coparenting Journey' (not 'Parent Journey'); on the no-court-key path the tab reads 'I. Alignment & Tools' and parent-journey-toolkit is visible; all 8 kept tiles present (assessment/safety/mediation/foundation/medical/educational/psychological/share-joint); both deleted tiles (alignment-before, joint-agreement) are absent; Foundation tile triggers a real download event with filename sacoparents-foundation-statement.pdf; Medical + Educational + Psychological tiles all scroll to Assessments section (scrollY ~993px, verified for each individually) and set folderFilter via setFolderFilter (openAssessmentFolder callback wired); Share-complete-report-btn POSTs to /api/portal/share with artefact_type='complete' and updates button text to 'Share link copied!' (intercepted + confirmed). Court-key path regression: entering ALIGN-SA-2026 verifies, tab switches to 'I. Legal Report & Alignment', parent-journey-toolkit hidden, Legal Report card visible. Iter77 flagged regression: advocate-review-tile visible in BIFF tab, add-milestone-btn reads '+ Log for advocate'. Iter75 grey-rock chip regression: biff-greyrock-chip visible under flagged state. No horizontal overflow at 390x844 on either the coparenting toolkit view or court-key path. ONE REAL BUG DISCOVERED (see frontend_issues): the fixed bottom-nav (z-40) overlaps the download-complete-report-btn (and by extension the share button) at the bottom of the scrollable toolkit region — a mouse click at the button's centre coordinate lands on the bottom-nav instead of the button. This is why my initial download expect_download() timed out: playwright's force=True click and a normal user tap both hit the NAV overlay. Confirmed by elementFromPoint() returning tag='NAV' data-testid='bottom-nav' at the button's centre. Keyboard Enter (after .focus()) does fire the handler and the API call succeeds. Fix: add bottom padding (pb-24 or so) to the AlignmentHub scroll container, OR raise the toolkit z-index above 40, OR give the .fixed bottom-nav a small ::before spacer / mb-safe.

ui_bugs.issue: The fixed bottom-nav (data-testid=bottom-nav, class 'fixed bottom-0 ... z-40') overlays download-complete-report-btn (and likely share-complete-report-btn) at 390x844. document.elementFromPoint at the button center returns the NAV, so real user taps + Playwright click(force=True) do NOT fire the button's onClick. The button IS keyboard-focusable and Enter DOES fire the axios POST, but this is not a usable mobile UX. Add bottom padding to the alignment scroll container (e.g. pb-24) or restructure so the toolkit CTA row sits above the fixed nav.

design_issues.screen: Coparenting Journey Toolkit — bottom of toolkit block on 390x844
issues: The two full-width CTAs (Download Complete Coparenting Report PDF + Share the Complete Report) render UNDER the fixed bottom-nav; a mobile tap will hit the nav instead. Needs pb-24 (or similar) on the scroll container.

action_items: Add bottom padding (e.g. pb-24 / pb-28) to the AlignmentHub tab container so the download-complete-report-btn + share-complete-report-btn are not obscured by the fixed bottom-nav (z-40) at 390x844. Alternatively, wrap the two CTAs in a section that lives above the bottom-nav or ensure the toolkit content ends at least 96px above the viewport bottom. Verify by opening portal '/', clicking door-parent-journey, and confirming document.elementFromPoint(cx, cy) of the download button no longer returns the NAV.
critical_code_review_comments: SacoparentsPortal.jsx still ~1539 lines — over the 700-line guideline; the new callbacks (openAssessmentFolder, buildCompleteReportPayload, downloadCompleteReportPdf, onShareCompleteReport) would fit cleanly in a usePortalCompleteReport hook alongside downloadPdfFromApi.

downloadPdfFromApi catches ALL errors with an alert() — a 422 (foundation_text > 8000 chars) will look identical to a network error. Consider surfacing the server detail via toast so parents can see 'too long' explicitly.

openAssessmentFolder uses a 60ms setTimeout before scrollIntoView — race-prone; would be more deterministic with useEffect on folderFilter + a ref to the section (works even if setState batching changes).

success_rate.frontend: 93% (13/14 checks — 1 real UI overlap bug on download/share complete-report buttons)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter78 backend endpoints are fully working (8/8 pytest green). The Coparenting Journey door label + tab label + toolkit tile shape (8 kept / 2 deleted) + Foundation download + Medical/Educational/Psychological scroll-and-filter + share-complete POST + court-key path regression all pass. The single outstanding issue is a z-order overlap: the fixed bottom-nav (z-40) covers the download-complete-report-btn and share-complete-report-btn at 390x844. To retest the fix: (1) load '/', seed safety_ack unflagged, click door-parent-journey, scroll to the two full-width CTAs; (2) call document.elementFromPoint at the button's bounding-box center — it should return the BUTTON, not NAV; (3) Playwright click(force=True) on download-complete-report-btn should trigger page.expect_download() with filename sacoparents-complete-report.pdf; (4) share-complete-report-btn should POST to /api/portal/share with artefact_type='complete'.
rca of the issue: On mobile 390x844 the AlignmentHub toolkit block ends flush with the bottom of the page area; the fixed bottom-nav (position:fixed; bottom:0; z-40) covers roughly the bottom ~64px of the viewport. The two new full-width CTAs (download-complete-report-btn + share-complete-report-btn) render just above the toolkit-grid — their bounding boxes land at y~804-830 which is inside the bottom-nav's occlusion zone. elementFromPoint(cx, cy) confirms the topmost element at the button center is NAV[data-testid=bottom-nav], so pointer/tap events dispatch to the nav (Doors/Report/BIFF/PDF Export tab) instead of the button. Keyboard focus + Enter bypasses the hit-test and fires the correct onClick, which is how I verified the underlying handlers + axios POST still work correctly. Mitigation: add pb-24 (or pb-28) to the AlignmentHub scroll container so its final children clear the fixed nav; alternatively promote the two CTAs into a sticky-above-nav slot with z-50.
